description: Figure: family-wide catalytic residue matrix for C. elegans cyclases and ODR-1 orthologs
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
d=pd.read_csv("celegans_cyclase_family_catalytic_scan.csv")
CAT=["Dmetal1","Dmetal2","Eguanine","Cguanine","Asn_TS","Arg_TS"]
EXP={"Dmetal1":"D","Dmetal2":"D","Eguanine":"E","Cguanine":"C","Asn_TS":"N","Arg_TS":"R"}
d=d.sort_values(["C1half","C2half","name"],ascending=[True,False,True]).reset_index(drop=True)
n=len(d)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,12.5))
for i,row in d.iterrows():
    for j,c in enumerate(CAT):
        v=str(row[c]); ok = v[:1]==EXP[c]
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((j,n-1-i),1,1,facecolor="#2f7d5c" if ok else "#b3402f",alpha=.85,ec="white",lw=1.6))
        ax.text(j+.5,n-1-i+.5,v,ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=7.6,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xlim(0,6); ax.set_ylim(0,n)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(6)+.5)
ax.set_xticklabels(["Asp-1\nmetal","Asp-2\nmetal","Glu\nguanine","Cys\nguanine","Asn\nTS","Arg\nTS"],fontsize=9)
labels=[f"{r['name']}  ({r['acc']})" for _,r in d.iterrows()][::-1]
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(n)+.5); ax.set_yticklabels(labels,fontsize=7.8)
for t in ax.get_yticklabels():
    if "odr-1" in t.get_text() or "daf-11" in t.get_text(): t.set_color("#8a2a1c"); t.set_fontweight("bold")
ax.tick_params(length=0)
for sp in ax.spines.values(): sp.set_visible(False)
ax.axvline(2,color="k",lw=2.2)
ax.text(1,n+0.5,"metal half (C1-type)",ha="center",fontsize=9.5,style="italic")
ax.text(4,n+0.5,"substrate / transition-state half (C2-type)",ha="center",fontsize=9.5,style="italic")
ax.set_title("Class III catalytic residues across all 33 C. elegans cyclases and 4 nematode ODR-1 orthologs\n"
             "green = canonical residue, red = substituted (rat GC-A reference columns)",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("Counts by half-site completeness:")
print(pd.crosstab(d["C1half"],d["C2half"]))
print("\nMetal-site-deficient (C1half==0):"); print(d[d.C1half==0][["name","acc","Dmetal1","Dmetal2","C2half"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nSubstrate-half-deficient (C2half<=2) with intact metal site:")
print(d[(d.C1half==2)&(d.C2half<=2)][["name","acc","Eguanine","Cguanine","Asn_TS","Arg_TS"]].to_string(index=False))
